column1: # Expected toolchain for the dioramap v3 quality suite — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH.
# Target: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. A run on any other target (e.g. a 24.04 box with
# gcc-13 / clang-18 / cmake-3) fails the precheck immediately instead of dying
# deep in a build. Bump these rows when the supported target LTS changes.
#   mode=exact    actual string must equal `expected`        (used for os)
#   mode=major    actual MAJOR version must equal `expected` (int compare)
#   mode=present  tool must merely exist on PATH             (`expected` ignored)
# Node + PostgreSQL track the 24.04 *deployment* box (agri-map + control-plane
# deploy there), NOT the 26.04 build host — hence node=24 (prod runs 24.15).
# PG is not exercised by run-tier (the quality suite installs no postgres), so
# it is intentionally absent here; it is pinned in the dev Dockerfile instead.
